wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
Relevant & Comprehensive RSE
Our dynamic & expert-led RSE sessions are designed to Empower, educate, and inspire.
Get Support with RSE
Mainstream Schools
At Tailor Education, we offer a dynamic range of RSE services specifically designed for mainstream schools. Our programs are crafted to resonate with a diverse student body, focusing on fostering a comprehensive understanding of relationships and sexual health.
Our goal is to equip students in mainstream schools with the knowledge and skills needed to navigate relationships and sexual health responsibly and respectfully.
How We Help Schools Embed Sustainable RSE
Key Aspects of Our Programs

Curriculum Integration

Our RSE content seamlessly integrates with existing curricula, enhancing the overall educational experience.

Engaging Activities

We employ interactive teaching methods, including discussions, role-play, and multimedia tools, to engage students actively.

Inclusivity and Sensitivity

Recognising the diverse backgrounds of students, our programs are inclusive and sensitive to various cultural, religious, and personal values.
Empathy & Inclusivity
We believe in promoting inclusivity and empathy and strive to show understanding and respect for diverse identities, cultures, and experiences. All our materials, resources, and lesson plans are designed not only to educate but to resonate with a wide array of learners. By weaving empathy and inclusivity into every aspect of our delivery, we aim to foster an environment where every student feels seen, heard, and valued.
Addressing Critical Issues
Tailor Education is committed to tackling critical societal issues head-on. Our workshops and discussion events delve into sensitive topics like sexual harassment and the nuances of masculinity. These discussions are framed in a manner that is respectful, age-appropriate, and thought-provoking, encouraging students to engage in meaningful conversations.
Comprehensive Curriculum Overview
Our curriculum is extensive and carefully crafted to address a wide range of topics relevant to young people today. From navigating sexual health services to fostering emotional health, from raising LGBTQ+ awareness to recognising and preventing abuse, our RSE programs offer comprehensive coverage, equipping students with the knowledge and skills they need for healthy, positive relationships.
“I just wanted to take time out to say a HUGE thank you for all your hard work yesterday. You’ve broken a wall of silence here at the academy and students are certainly more interested in opening up and seeking help and support in this area. The students even gave feedback that they wanted you to return and talk about other issues relating to SRE.”
Victoria Oladele – Careers First Academy
Explore Our Wide Range of RSE Topics
As well as information workshops on things like puberty, contraception and sexually transmitted infections, we also provide educational workshops on a range of other issues facing young people including consent, domestic violence, sexual bullying, porn literacy, online safety, CSE and more.
Explore All Topics

Consent

LGBTQ+

Masculinity & Male Privilege

Porn Literacy

Creating Sustainable RSE Delivery
Tailor Education’s mission extends beyond just presenting a program; we aim to embed high-quality Relationships & Sex Education (RSE) in a manner that is enduring and evolves with the needs of students, particularly those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND). Our comprehensive support structure ensures that RSE is not just a one-off program but a lasting element of a school’s curriculum.
How we do it:

Holistic Curriculum Design

Our team collaborates with schools to craft RSE lesson plans that are not only inclusive but also resonate with the lived experiences of SEND students. We emphasize a curriculum that is flexible, allowing it to be tailored to the unique needs and learning styles of each classroom. This approach ensures that every student receives RSE that is accessible, understandable, and relevant to their lives.

RSE Policy Support

Navigating the intricacies of educational policies can be challenging. We provide expert guidance in interpreting and applying RSE policies, helping schools to align their curriculum with current regulations and best practices. This includes assistance in drafting or revising school RSE policies to reflect an inclusive and comprehensive approach.

All-staff Training

To ensure the effective delivery of RSE, it’s essential that all staff members, not just teachers, are equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills. We offer specialized training sessions that empower every member of the school community — from teachers to support staff — with the confidence and capability to contribute to the RSE learning environment.

Parental Engagement

Engaging parents and caregivers is a critical aspect of successful RSE. We facilitate workshops and provide resources to help schools in establishing constructive dialogues with parents. This involves addressing their concerns, providing clarity on the RSE curriculum, and exploring ways parents can support their children’s learning at home.

Continued Access to RSE Resources

We understand that RSE is an evolving field. Our commitment includes providing schools with ongoing access to up-to-date resources, including teaching materials, research updates, and best-practice guides. This ensures that schools can continuously refresh and enhance their RSE provision.

Ongoing Support

Our relationship with schools is not transactional but a partnership. We offer ongoing support, including follow-up visits, consultation sessions, and refresher training. This ensures that schools feel supported at every step and can confidently address new challenges or changes in their student population.
Let’s Collaborate
We invite you to partner with us in bringing high-quality RSE to your secondary school. Together, we can make a significant impact on the lives of young people, helping them navigate the complexities of relationships and emotional health with confidence and clarity.
Contact Us Now
FAQs
Got questions? Find answers to common queries about our workshops here.

What age groups do your RSE sessions cater to?

Our RSE sessions are designed for a wide age range, from early years to young adults, ensuring age-appropriate content for each group.

Can you provide RSE training for educators and professionals?

Yes, we offer in-depth training for educators and professionals to enhance their confidence and competence in delivering RSE.

Do your programs include topics on digital safety and online relationships?

Absolutely. We cover digital safety and online relationships, teaching young people about the risks and responsible behavior in the digital world.

How do you ensure your RSE programs are inclusive?

Our programs are developed with inclusivity at their core, addressing diverse needs, including those of the LGBTQ+ community and students with disabilities.

What methods do you use to engage young people in RSE?

We use interactive and engaging methods like discussions, role-plays, and multimedia resources to make RSE relatable and effective for young people.

Can Tailor Education provide specialized RSE sessions for vulnerable youth?

Yes, we offer targeted RSE programs for young people at higher risk of harmful relationships, early pregnancy, and poor sexual health.

Are your RSE sessions aligned with current educational guidelines and policies?

Yes, our sessions are designed in accordance with the latest educational guidelines and policies to ensure they meet national standards.

How do you measure the impact of your RSE programs?

We assess the impact through feedback surveys, participant engagement, and pre- and post-session evaluations.

Do you offer online RSE sessions and resources?

Yes, we offer both online sessions and digital resources, making our RSE programs accessible to a wider audience.

Our teaching methods are highly adaptable; to cater to students in Alternative Provision (AP) such as Pupil Referral Units, Home Education Groups, and Medical Tuition Services.

Our aim is to ensure every young person, regardless of their learning environment, has access to high-quality, empathetic, and relevant RSE.

Inclusivity and Sensitivity

Our RSE programs are conscientiously designed to be inclusive and sensitive to the unique needs of all learners, including those with learning disabilities, autism, or facing emotional and social challenges. We integrate strategies that foster resilience, autonomy, and self-awareness, ensuring every student feels seen, heard, and valued.

Addressing Critical Issues

Tailor Education is committed to tackling critical societal issues head-on. Our workshops and discussion events delve into sensitive topics like sexual harassment and the nuances of masculinity. These discussions are framed in a manner that is respectful, age-appropriate, and thought-provoking, encouraging students to engage in meaningful conversations.

Comprehensive Curriculum Overview

Our curriculum is extensive and carefully crafted to address a wide range of topics relevant to young people today. From navigating sexual health services to fostering emotional health, from raising LGBTQ+ awareness to recognising and preventing abuse, our RSE programs offer comprehensive coverage, equipping students with the knowledge and skills they need for healthy, positive relationships.

Creating Sustainable RSE Delivery

Tailor Education's mission extends beyond just presenting a program; we aim to embed high-quality Relationships & Sex Education (RSE) in a manner that is enduring and evolves with the needs of students, particularly those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND). Our comprehensive support structure ensures that RSE is not just a one-off program but a lasting element of a school's curriculum.

How we do it:

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_accordion open_toggle_text_color="#000000" open_toggle_background_color="rgba(22,169,146,0.1)" closed_toggle_text_color="#000000" closed_toggle_background_color="#f2f2f2" toggle_icon="3||divi||400" icon_color="#39424b" use_icon_font_size="on" icon_font_size="18px" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" toggle_level="h4" toggle_font="|300|||||||" closed_toggle_font="|300|||||||" body_font="|300|||||||" body_text_color="#39424B" body_font_size="17px" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" border_width_all="0px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_accordion_item title="Holistic Curriculum Design" open="on" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

Our team collaborates with schools to craft RSE lesson plans that are not only inclusive but also resonate with the lived experiences of SEND students. We emphasize a curriculum that is flexible, allowing it to be tailored to the unique needs and learning styles of each classroom. This approach ensures that every student receives RSE that is accessible, understandable, and relevant to their lives.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="RSE Policy Support" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

Navigating the intricacies of educational policies can be challenging. We provide expert guidance in interpreting and applying RSE policies, helping schools to align their curriculum with current regulations and best practices. This includes assistance in drafting or revising school RSE policies to reflect an inclusive and comprehensive approach.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="All-staff Training" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

To ensure the effective delivery of RSE, it's essential that all staff members, not just teachers, are equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills. We offer specialized training sessions that empower every member of the school community — from teachers to support staff — with the confidence and capability to contribute to the RSE learning environment.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Parental Engagement" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

Engaging parents and caregivers is a critical aspect of successful RSE. We facilitate workshops and provide resources to help schools in establishing constructive dialogues with parents. This involves addressing their concerns, providing clarity on the RSE curriculum, and exploring ways parents can support their children’s learning at home.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Continued Access to RSE Resources" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

We understand that RSE is an evolving field. Our commitment includes providing schools with ongoing access to up-to-date resources, including teaching materials, research updates, and best-practice guides. This ensures that schools can continuously refresh and enhance their RSE provision.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Ongoing Support" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

Our relationship with schools is not transactional but a partnership. We offer ongoing support, including follow-up visits, consultation sessions, and refresher training. This ensures that schools feel supported at every step and can confidently address new challenges or changes in their student population.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][/et_pb_accordion][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="24px||||false|false" locked="off" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

Let's Collaborate

We invite you to partner with us in bringing high-quality RSE to your secondary school. Together, we can make a significant impact on the lives of young people, helping them navigate the complexities of relationships and emotional health with confidence and clarity.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_button button_url="@ET-DC@eyJkeW5hbWljIjp0cnVlLCJjb250ZW50IjoicG9zdF9saW5rX3VybF9wYWdlIiwic2V0dGluZ3MiOnsicG9zdF9pZCI6IjE1NSJ9fQ==@" button_text="Contact Us Now" _builder_version="4.23.1" _dynamic_attributes="button_url" _module_preset="_initial" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_button][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" background_enable_color="off" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_row disabled_on="off|off|off" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" text_orientation="center" global_colors_info="{}"]

FAQs

Got questions? Find answers to common queries about our workshops here.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_accordion open_toggle_text_color="#000000" open_toggle_background_color="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_text_color="#000000" closed_toggle_background_color="#efefef" toggle_icon="L||divi||400" icon_color="#39424b" use_icon_font_size="on" icon_font_size="18px" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" toggle_level="h4" toggle_font="|300|||||||" closed_toggle_font="|300|||||||" body_font="|300|||||||" body_text_color="#39424B" body_font_size="17px" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" border_width_all="0px" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="off|desktop" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(138,100,181,0.2)"][et_pb_accordion_item title="What age groups do your RSE sessions cater to?" open="on" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover"]

Our RSE sessions are designed for a wide age range, from early years to young adults, ensuring age-appropriate content for each group.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Can you provide RSE training for educators and professionals?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Yes, we offer in-depth training for educators and professionals to enhance their confidence and competence in delivering RSE.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Do your programs include topics on digital safety and online relationships?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Absolutely. We cover digital safety and online relationships, teaching young people about the risks and responsible behavior in the digital world.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="How do you ensure your RSE programs are inclusive?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Our programs are developed with inclusivity at their core, addressing diverse needs, including those of the LGBTQ+ community and students with disabilities.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="What methods do you use to engage young people in RSE?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

We use interactive and engaging methods like discussions, role-plays, and multimedia resources to make RSE relatable and effective for young people.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Can Tailor Education provide specialised RSE sessions for vulnerable youth?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Yes, we offer targeted RSE programs for young people at higher risk of harmful relationships, early pregnancy, and poor sexual health.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Are your RSE sessions aligned with current educational guidelines and policies?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Yes, our sessions are designed in accordance with the latest educational guidelines and policies to ensure they meet national standards.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="How do you measure the impact of your RSE programs?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

We assess the impact through feedback surveys, participant engagement, and pre- and post-session evaluations.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Do you offer online RSE sessions and resources?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Yes, we offer both online sessions and digital resources, making our RSE programs accessible to a wider audience.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][/et_pb_accordion][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

Inclusive & Engaging RSE
Navigating unique educational paths with tailored RSE for Alternative Provision. Explore our adaptable, inclusive approach.
Get Help with RSE at Your School
Flexible RSE for Alternative Provision
At Tailor Education, we specialise in delivering Relationships & Sex Education (RSE) across diverse learning environments. Our teaching methods are highly adaptable; to cater to students in Alternative Provision (AP) such as Pupil Referral Units, Home Education Groups, and Medical Tuition Services.
Our aim is to ensure every young person, regardless of their learning environment, has access to high-quality, empathetic, and relevant RSE.
Learn More About Creating Sustainable RSE at Your School
How We Adapt to the Needs of Your Learners

Customised Content

Tailored to address the specific situations and learning styles of AP students and informal learners.

Engaging Activities

We employ interactive teaching methods, including discussions, role-play, and multimedia tools, to engage students actively.

Experienced Educators

Our team brings empathy and expertise, essential for diverse audiences in AP and informal settings.
Inclusivity and Sensitivity
Our RSE programs are conscientiously designed to be inclusive and sensitive to the unique needs of all learners, including those with learning disabilities, autism, or facing emotional and social challenges. We integrate strategies that foster resilience, autonomy, and self-awareness, ensuring every student feels seen, heard, and valued.
Addressing Critical Issues
Tailor Education is committed to tackling critical societal issues head-on. Our workshops and discussion events delve into sensitive topics like sexual harassment and the nuances of masculinity. These discussions are framed in a manner that is respectful, age-appropriate, and thought-provoking, encouraging students to engage in meaningful conversations.
Comprehensive Curriculum Overview
Our curriculum is extensive and carefully crafted to address a wide range of topics relevant to young people today. From navigating sexual health services to fostering emotional health, from raising LGBTQ+ awareness to recognising and preventing abuse, our RSE programs offer comprehensive coverage, equipping students with the knowledge and skills they need for healthy, positive relationships.
We have some of the most challenging young people in Camden, however, your SRE lessons always engage and motivate our students to learn. You have always worked with us to adapt the learning to the needs of our young people. Thank you for your support.
Ashley Summercorn – Camden Centre for Learning
Explore Our Wide Range of RSE Topics
We deliver RSE workshops on a comprehensive range of topics, tailored for primary schools. Our curriculum is designed to empower students with the knowledge and skills for positive relationships and emotional health.
Explore All Topics

Body Awareness

Respectful Relationships

Personal Safety

Emotional Health

Creating Sustainable RSE Delivery
Tailor Education’s mission extends beyond just presenting a program; we aim to embed high-quality Relationships & Sex Education (RSE) in a manner that is enduring and evolves with the needs of students, particularly those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND). Our comprehensive support structure ensures that RSE is not just a one-off program but a lasting element of a school’s curriculum.
How we do it:

Holistic Curriculum Design

Our team collaborates with schools to craft RSE lesson plans that are not only inclusive but also resonate with the lived experiences of SEND students. We emphasize a curriculum that is flexible, allowing it to be tailored to the unique needs and learning styles of each classroom. This approach ensures that every student receives RSE that is accessible, understandable, and relevant to their lives.

RSE Policy Support

Navigating the intricacies of educational policies can be challenging. We provide expert guidance in interpreting and applying RSE policies, helping schools to align their curriculum with current regulations and best practices. This includes assistance in drafting or revising school RSE policies to reflect an inclusive and comprehensive approach.

All-staff Training

To ensure the effective delivery of RSE, it’s essential that all staff members, not just teachers, are equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills. We offer specialized training sessions that empower every member of the school community — from teachers to support staff — with the confidence and capability to contribute to the RSE learning environment.

Parental Engagement

Engaging parents and caregivers is a critical aspect of successful RSE. We facilitate workshops and provide resources to help schools in establishing constructive dialogues with parents. This involves addressing their concerns, providing clarity on the RSE curriculum, and exploring ways parents can support their children’s learning at home.

Continued Access to RSE Resources

We understand that RSE is an evolving field. Our commitment includes providing schools with ongoing access to up-to-date resources, including teaching materials, research updates, and best-practice guides. This ensures that schools can continuously refresh and enhance their RSE provision.

Ongoing Support

Our relationship with schools is not transactional but a partnership. We offer ongoing support, including follow-up visits, consultation sessions, and refresher training. This ensures that schools feel supported at every step and can confidently address new challenges or changes in their student population.
Let’s Collaborate
We invite you to partner with us in bringing high-quality RSE to your secondary school. Together, we can make a significant impact on the lives of young people, helping them navigate the complexities of relationships and emotional health with confidence and clarity.
Contact Us Now
FAQs
Got questions? Find answers to common queries about our workshops here.

What age groups do your RSE sessions cater to?

Our RSE sessions are designed for a wide age range, from early years to young adults, ensuring age-appropriate content for each group.

Can you provide RSE training for educators and professionals?

Yes, we offer in-depth training for educators and professionals to enhance their confidence and competence in delivering RSE.

Do your programs include topics on digital safety and online relationships?

Absolutely. We cover digital safety and online relationships, teaching young people about the risks and responsible behavior in the digital world.

How do you ensure your RSE programs are inclusive?

Our programs are developed with inclusivity at their core, addressing diverse needs, including those of the LGBTQ+ community and students with disabilities.

What methods do you use to engage young people in RSE?

We use interactive and engaging methods like discussions, role-plays, and multimedia resources to make RSE relatable and effective for young people.

Can Tailor Education provide specialised RSE sessions for vulnerable youth?

Yes, we offer targeted RSE programs for young people at higher risk of harmful relationships, early pregnancy, and poor sexual health.

Are your RSE sessions aligned with current educational guidelines and policies?

Yes, our sessions are designed in accordance with the latest educational guidelines and policies to ensure they meet national standards.

How do you measure the impact of your RSE programs?

We assess the impact through feedback surveys, participant engagement, and pre- and post-session evaluations.

Do you offer online RSE sessions and resources?

Yes, we offer both online sessions and digital resources, making our RSE programs accessible to a wider audience.

Specialised RSE for Special Schools

At Tailor Education, we have years of experience working with students who have Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND). Our RSE programs are designed to help these young people build the resilience, autonomy, and self-awareness, crucial for their safe and confident progression through adolescence and adulthood.

Our primary goal is to equip students in special schools with a well-rounded understanding of relationships and sexual health. By acknowledging and respecting each student's unique perspective and experience, we aim to empower them with the knowledge and confidence needed to make informed decisions and develop healthy relationships.

Our Approach

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_3,1_3,1_3" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="10px||||false|false" locked="off" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" background_color="#efefef" custom_padding="2%|2%|2%|2%|true|true" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://tailoreducation.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Tailor-Education-RSE-Curriculum-Integration-Icon-2.svg" title_text="Tailor Education RSE Curriculum Integration Icon 2" align="center" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" height="64px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_blurb title="Tailored Lesson Plans" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" body_text_color="#39424B" text_orientation="center" global_colors_info="{}"]

Our curriculum is carefully modified to align with the cognitive, emotional, and physical abilities of students in special schools, ensuring that each lesson is relevant and accessible.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" background_color="#efefef" custom_padding="2%|2%|2%|2%|true|true" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://tailoreducation.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Tailor-Education-RSE-Engaging-Activities-Icon.svg" title_text="Tailor Education RSE Engaging Activities Icon" align="center" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" height="64px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_blurb title="Multi-Sensory Teaching Techniques" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" body_text_color="#39424B" text_orientation="center" global_colors_info="{}" content__hover_enabled="off|desktop"]

We employ a range of sensory-rich educational methods, including visual aids, tactile learning tools, and interactive activities, to cater to different learning styles and needs.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" background_color="#efefef" custom_padding="2%|2%|2%|2%|true|true" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://tailoreducation.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Tailor-Education-RSE-Inclusivity-and-Sensitivity-Icon-2.svg" title_text="Tailor Education RSE Inclusivity and Sensitivity Icon 2" align="center" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" height="64px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_blurb title="Safe & Empathetic Learning Spaces" alt="Emotional Health" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" body_text_color="#39424B" text_orientation="center" global_colors_info="{}"]

Our educators are specially trained to foster a nurturing and patient learning environment. This approach encourages open communication and ensures that students feel comfortable and supported to learn.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_4,1_4,1_4,1_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="10px||||false|false" locked="off" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" custom_css_main_element="width: 14% !important;" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" background_color="#efefef" custom_padding="2%|2%|2%|2%|true|true" custom_css_main_element="width: 31.3% !important;" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://tailoreducation.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Tailor-Education-RSE-Collaboration-Icon.svg" title_text="Tailor Education RSE Collaboration Icon" align="center" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" height="64px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_blurb title="Collaboration with Teachers" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" body_text_color="#39424B" text_orientation="center" global_colors_info="{}"]

We work closely with teachers and support staff to create a cohesive and integrated learning experience that complements the students' overall educational plan.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" background_color="#efefef" custom_padding="2%|2%|2%|2%|true|true" custom_css_main_element="width: 31.3% !important;" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://tailoreducation.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Tailor-Education-RSE-Sensitive-Topic-Icon.svg" title_text="Tailor Education RSE Sensitive Topic Icon" align="center" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" height="64px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_blurb title="Addressing Sensitive Topics" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" body_text_color="#39424B" text_orientation="center" global_colors_info="{}" content__hover_enabled="off|desktop"]

We tackle sensitive topics like puberty, sex, privacy, and hygiene with care and expertise, easing the anxieties of educators while providing suitable support for students.

Creating Sustainable RSE Delivery

Tailor Education's mission extends beyond just presenting a program; we aim to embed high-quality Relationships & Sex Education (RSE) in a manner that is enduring and evolves with the needs of students, particularly those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND). Our comprehensive support structure ensures that RSE is not just a one-off program but a lasting element of a school's curriculum.

How we do it:

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_accordion open_toggle_text_color="#000000" open_toggle_background_color="rgba(22,169,146,0.1)" closed_toggle_text_color="#000000" closed_toggle_background_color="#f2f2f2" toggle_icon="3||divi||400" icon_color="#39424b" use_icon_font_size="on" icon_font_size="18px" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" toggle_level="h4" toggle_font="|300|||||||" closed_toggle_font="|300|||||||" body_font="|300|||||||" body_text_color="#39424B" body_font_size="17px" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" border_width_all="0px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_accordion_item title="Holistic Curriculum Design" open="on" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

Our team collaborates with schools to craft RSE lesson plans that are not only inclusive but also resonate with the lived experiences of SEND students. We emphasize a curriculum that is flexible, allowing it to be tailored to the unique needs and learning styles of each classroom. This approach ensures that every student receives RSE that is accessible, understandable, and relevant to their lives.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="RSE Policy Support" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

Navigating the intricacies of educational policies can be challenging. We provide expert guidance in interpreting and applying RSE policies, helping schools to align their curriculum with current regulations and best practices. This includes assistance in drafting or revising school RSE policies to reflect an inclusive and comprehensive approach.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="All-staff Training" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

To ensure the effective delivery of RSE, it's essential that all staff members, not just teachers, are equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills. We offer specialized training sessions that empower every member of the school community — from teachers to support staff — with the confidence and capability to contribute to the RSE learning environment.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Parental Engagement" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

Engaging parents and caregivers is a critical aspect of successful RSE. We facilitate workshops and provide resources to help schools in establishing constructive dialogues with parents. This involves addressing their concerns, providing clarity on the RSE curriculum, and exploring ways parents can support their children’s learning at home.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Continued Access to RSE Resources" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

We understand that RSE is an evolving field. Our commitment includes providing schools with ongoing access to up-to-date resources, including teaching materials, research updates, and best-practice guides. This ensures that schools can continuously refresh and enhance their RSE provision.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Ongoing Support" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" open="off"]

Our relationship with schools is not transactional but a partnership. We offer ongoing support, including follow-up visits, consultation sessions, and refresher training. This ensures that schools feel supported at every step and can confidently address new challenges or changes in their student population.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][/et_pb_accordion][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" module_id="testimonial" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" locked="off" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb image="https://tailoreducation.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Tailor-SRE-Sex-Education-Avatar-Victoria-Oladele.png" icon_placement="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" header_level="h6" header_font="Comfortaa|800|||||||" header_text_color="#16A992" body_font="Comfortaa|500|||||||" body_text_color="#16A992" body_font_size="28px" body_letter_spacing="-1px" body_line_height="1.5em" background_enable_color="off" custom_css_blurb_image="width: 100px;||" custom_css_blurb_title="margin-top: 10px;" global_colors_info="{}"]

"I just wanted to take time out to say a HUGE thank you for all your hard work yesterday. You've broken a wall of silence here at the academy and students are certainly more interested in opening up and seeking help and support in this area. The students even gave feedback that they wanted you to return and talk about other issues relating to SRE."

Victoria Oladele - Careers First Academy

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="24px||||false|false" locked="off" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

Let's Collaborate

We invite you to partner with us in bringing high-quality RSE to your secondary school. Together, we can make a significant impact on the lives of young people, helping them navigate the complexities of relationships and emotional health with confidence and clarity.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_button button_url="@ET-DC@eyJkeW5hbWljIjp0cnVlLCJjb250ZW50IjoicG9zdF9saW5rX3VybF9wYWdlIiwic2V0dGluZ3MiOnsicG9zdF9pZCI6IjE1NSJ9fQ==@" button_text="Contact Us Now" _builder_version="4.23.1" _dynamic_attributes="button_url" _module_preset="_initial" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_button][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" background_enable_color="off" global_colors_info="{}" locked="off"][et_pb_row disabled_on="off|off|off" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" text_orientation="center" global_colors_info="{}"]

FAQs

Got questions? Find answers to common queries about our workshops here.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_accordion open_toggle_text_color="#000000" open_toggle_background_color="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_text_color="#000000" closed_toggle_background_color="#efefef" toggle_icon="L||divi||400" icon_color="#39424b" use_icon_font_size="on" icon_font_size="18px" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" toggle_level="h4" toggle_font="|300|||||||" closed_toggle_font="|300|||||||" body_font="|300|||||||" body_text_color="#39424B" body_font_size="17px" border_radii="on|10px|10px|10px|10px" border_width_all="0px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_accordion_item title="What age groups do your RSE sessions cater to?" open="on" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover"]

Our RSE sessions are designed for a wide age range, from early years to young adults, ensuring age-appropriate content for each group.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Can you provide RSE training for educators and professionals?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Yes, we offer in-depth training for educators and professionals to enhance their confidence and competence in delivering RSE.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="Do your programs include topics on digital safety and online relationships?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Absolutely. We cover digital safety and online relationships, teaching young people about the risks and responsible behavior in the digital world.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="How do you ensure your RSE programs are inclusive?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

Our programs are developed with inclusivity at their core, addressing diverse needs, including those of the LGBTQ+ community and students with disabilities.

[/et_pb_accordion_item][et_pb_accordion_item title="What methods do you use to engage young people in RSE?" _builder_version="4.23.1" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}" closed_toggle_background_color__hover="rgba(22,169,146,0.15)" closed_toggle_background_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" open="off"]

We use interactive and engaging methods like discussions, role-plays, and multimedia resources to make RSE relatable and effective for young people.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
Supportive & Holistic RSE
Our specialised RSE is designed to empower students with a safer, more informed future. Discover how we work with special schools.
Get Help with RSE at Your School
Specialised RSE for Special Schools
At Tailor Education, we have years of experience working with students who have Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND). Our RSE programs are designed to help these young people build the resilience, autonomy, and self-awareness, crucial for their safe and confident progression through adolescence and adulthood.
Our primary goal is to equip students in special schools with a well-rounded understanding of relationships and sexual health. By acknowledging and respecting each student’s unique perspective and experience, we aim to empower them with the knowledge and confidence needed to make informed decisions and develop healthy relationships.
Learn More About Creating Sustainable RSE at Your School
Our Approach

Tailored Lesson Plans

Our curriculum is carefully modified to align with the cognitive, emotional, and physical abilities of students in special schools, ensuring that each lesson is relevant and accessible.

Multi-Sensory Teaching Techniques

We employ a range of sensory-rich educational methods, including visual aids, tactile learning tools, and interactive activities, to cater to different learning styles and needs.

Safe & Empathetic Learning Spaces

Our educators are specially trained to foster a nurturing and patient learning environment. This approach encourages open communication and ensures that students feel comfortable and supported to learn.

Collaboration with Teachers

We work closely with teachers and support staff to create a cohesive and integrated learning experience that complements the students’ overall educational plan.

Addressing Sensitive Topics

We tackle sensitive topics like puberty, sex, privacy, and hygiene with care and expertise, easing the anxieties of educators while providing suitable support for students.
Explore Our Wide Range of RSE Topics
We deliver RSE workshops on a comprehensive range of topics, tailored for primary schools. Our curriculum is designed to empower students with the knowledge and skills for positive relationships and emotional health.
Explore All Topics

Body Awareness

Respectful Relationships

Personal Safety

Emotional Health

Creating Sustainable RSE Delivery
Tailor Education’s mission extends beyond just presenting a program; we aim to embed high-quality Relationships & Sex Education (RSE) in a manner that is enduring and evolves with the needs of students, particularly those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND). Our comprehensive support structure ensures that RSE is not just a one-off program but a lasting element of a school’s curriculum.
How we do it:

Holistic Curriculum Design

Our team collaborates with schools to craft RSE lesson plans that are not only inclusive but also resonate with the lived experiences of SEND students. We emphasize a curriculum that is flexible, allowing it to be tailored to the unique needs and learning styles of each classroom. This approach ensures that every student receives RSE that is accessible, understandable, and relevant to their lives.

RSE Policy Support

Navigating the intricacies of educational policies can be challenging. We provide expert guidance in interpreting and applying RSE policies, helping schools to align their curriculum with current regulations and best practices. This includes assistance in drafting or revising school RSE policies to reflect an inclusive and comprehensive approach.

All-staff Training

To ensure the effective delivery of RSE, it’s essential that all staff members, not just teachers, are equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills. We offer specialized training sessions that empower every member of the school community — from teachers to support staff — with the confidence and capability to contribute to the RSE learning environment.

Parental Engagement

Engaging parents and caregivers is a critical aspect of successful RSE. We facilitate workshops and provide resources to help schools in establishing constructive dialogues with parents. This involves addressing their concerns, providing clarity on the RSE curriculum, and exploring ways parents can support their children’s learning at home.

Continued Access to RSE Resources

We understand that RSE is an evolving field. Our commitment includes providing schools with ongoing access to up-to-date resources, including teaching materials, research updates, and best-practice guides. This ensures that schools can continuously refresh and enhance their RSE provision.

Ongoing Support

Our relationship with schools is not transactional but a partnership. We offer ongoing support, including follow-up visits, consultation sessions, and refresher training. This ensures that schools feel supported at every step and can confidently address new challenges or changes in their student population.
“I just wanted to take time out to say a HUGE thank you for all your hard work yesterday. You’ve broken a wall of silence here at the academy and students are certainly more interested in opening up and seeking help and support in this area. The students even gave feedback that they wanted you to return and talk about other issues relating to SRE.”
Victoria Oladele – Careers First Academy
Let’s Collaborate
We invite you to partner with us in bringing high-quality RSE to your secondary school. Together, we can make a significant impact on the lives of young people, helping them navigate the complexities of relationships and emotional health with confidence and clarity.
Contact Us Now
FAQs
Got questions? Find answers to common queries about our workshops here.

What age groups do your RSE sessions cater to?

Our RSE sessions are designed for a wide age range, from early years to young adults, ensuring age-appropriate content for each group.

Can you provide RSE training for educators and professionals?

Yes, we offer in-depth training for educators and professionals to enhance their confidence and competence in delivering RSE.

Do your programs include topics on digital safety and online relationships?

Absolutely. We cover digital safety and online relationships, teaching young people about the risks and responsible behavior in the digital world.

How do you ensure your RSE programs are inclusive?

Our programs are developed with inclusivity at their core, addressing diverse needs, including those of the LGBTQ+ community and students with disabilities.

What methods do you use to engage young people in RSE?

We use interactive and engaging methods like discussions, role-plays, and multimedia resources to make RSE relatable and effective for young people.

Can Tailor Education provide specialized RSE sessions for vulnerable youth?

Yes, we offer targeted RSE programs for young people at higher risk of harmful relationships, early pregnancy, and poor sexual health.

Are your RSE sessions aligned with current educational guidelines and policies?

Yes, our sessions are designed in accordance with the latest educational guidelines and policies to ensure they meet national standards.

How do you measure the impact of your RSE programs?

We assess the impact through feedback surveys, participant engagement, and pre- and post-session evaluations.

Do you offer online RSE sessions and resources?

Yes, we offer both online sessions and digital resources, making our RSE programs accessible to a wider audience.

Every child deserves a strong foundation in understanding relationships and personal well-being. In a world where children are increasingly exposed to varied, complex and potentially harmful content, providing them with clear, age-appropriate, and factual RSE is not just necessary, it's vital.

Our RSE programs are more than just lessons; they are pathways to empower young minds with knowledge, confidence, and values. We pride ourselves on creating a safe, inclusive, and engaging learning environment where every primary school student feels valued and heard.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
Interactive & Inspiring RSE
Our specialised RSE is designed to empower students with a safer, more informed future. Discover how we work with special schools.
Contact Us to Book
Foundational RSE for Primary Schools
Every child deserves a strong foundation in understanding relationships and personal well-being. In a world where children are increasingly exposed to varied, complex and potentially harmful content, providing them with clear, age-appropriate, and factual RSE is not just necessary, it’s vital.
Our RSE programs are more than just lessons; they are pathways to empower young minds with knowledge, confidence, and values. We pride ourselves on creating a safe, inclusive, and engaging learning environment where every primary school student feels valued and heard.
Learn More about Creating Sustainable RSE at Your School
Key Aspects of Our Delivery

Age-Appropriate Content

All our lessons are carefully crafted to ensure that we provide just the right amount of information to satisfy their curiosity and help them understand their experiences.

Engaging Activities

We use varied interactive methods such as storytelling, role-playing, and group discussions to make learning about relationships fun and memorable.

Experienced Educators

Our lessons are inclusive and accessible to all students, including those with special educational needs (SEND). We ensure every child feels included and safe.

Body Awareness

Respectful Relationships

Personal Safety

Emotional Health

Explore Our Wide Range of RSE Topics
We deliver RSE workshops on a comprehensive range of topics, tailored for primary schools. Our curriculum is designed to empower students with the knowledge and skills for positive relationships and emotional health.
Explore All Topics
Creating Sustainable RSE Delivery
Tailor Education’s mission extends beyond just presenting a program; we aim to embed high-quality Relationships & Sex Education (RSE) in a manner that is enduring and evolves with the needs of students, particularly those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND). Our comprehensive support structure ensures that RSE is not just a one-off program but a lasting element of a school’s curriculum.
How we do it:

Holistic Curriculum Design

Our team collaborates with schools to craft RSE lesson plans that are not only inclusive but also resonate with the lived experiences of students with SEND. We emphasise a flexible curriculum, allowing it to be tailored to each classroom’s unique needs and learning styles. This approach ensures that every student receives RSE that is accessible, understandable, and relevant to their lives.

RSE Policy Support

Navigating the intricacies of educational policies can be challenging. We provide expert guidance in interpreting and applying RSE policies, helping schools to align their curriculum with current regulations and best practices. This includes assistance in drafting or revising school RSE policies to reflect an inclusive and comprehensive approach.

All-staff Training

To ensure the effective delivery of RSE, it’s essential that all staff members, not just teachers, are equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills. We offer specialised training sessions that empower every member of the school community — from teachers to support staff — with the confidence and capability to contribute to the RSE learning environment.

Parental Engagement

Engaging parents and caregivers is a critical aspect of successful RSE. We facilitate workshops and provide resources to help schools in establishing constructive dialogues with parents. This involves addressing their concerns, providing clarity on the RSE curriculum, and exploring ways parents can support their children’s learning at home.

Continued Access to RSE Resources

We understand that RSE is an evolving field. Our commitment includes providing schools with ongoing access to up-to-date resources, including teaching materials, research updates, and best-practice guides. This ensures that schools can continuously refresh and enhance their RSE provision.

Ongoing Support

Our relationship with schools is not transactional but a partnership. We offer ongoing support, including follow-up visits, consultation sessions, and refresher training. This ensures that schools feel supported at every step and can confidently address new challenges or changes in their student population.
Let’s Collaborate
We invite you to partner with us in bringing high-quality RSE to your secondary school. Together, we can make a significant impact on the lives of young people, helping them navigate the complexities of relationships and emotional health with confidence and clarity.
Contact Us Now
FAQs
Got questions? Find answers to common queries about our workshops here.

What age groups do your RSE sessions cater to?

Our RSE sessions are designed for a wide age range, from early years to young adults, ensuring age-appropriate content for each group.

Can you provide RSE training for educators and professionals?

Yes, we offer in-depth training for educators and professionals to enhance their confidence and competence in delivering RSE.

Do your programs include topics on digital safety and online relationships?

Absolutely. We cover digital safety and online relationships, teaching young people about the risks and responsible behavior in the digital world.

How do you ensure your RSE programs are inclusive?

Our programs are developed with inclusivity at their core, addressing diverse needs, including those of the LGBTQ+ community and students with disabilities.

What methods do you use to engage young people in RSE?

We use interactive and engaging methods like discussions, role-plays, and multimedia resources to make RSE relatable and effective for young people.

Can Tailor Education provide specialized RSE sessions for vulnerable youth?

Yes, we offer targeted RSE programs for young people at higher risk of harmful relationships, early pregnancy, and poor sexual health.

Are your RSE sessions aligned with current educational guidelines and policies?

Yes, our sessions are designed in accordance with the latest educational guidelines and policies to ensure they meet national standards.

How do you measure the impact of your RSE programs?

We assess the impact through feedback surveys, participant engagement, and pre- and post-session evaluations.

Do you offer online RSE sessions and resources?

Yes, we offer both online sessions and digital resources, making our RSE programs accessible to a wider audience.

item.title: Work Out: Powerful Consent Education for Men Through Art, Sport, and Dialogue
item.dc:creator: gareth
item.content:encoded:
At Tailor Education, we recently contributed to a pioneering initiative reshaping how we think about consent education for men in university settings. The "Work Out" project, a collaboration between Somerset House Studios, King’s College London, and a dynamic group of educators, artists, and researchers, represents a bold and timely approach to tackling some of the most pressing issues in Relationships and Sex Education (RSE). This was not a traditional educational project — it used creative methodologies, lived experience, and active dialogue to foster real transformation.

Reimagining Consent Education for Men

Born from a shared recognition that traditional sex education often fails to engage men meaningfully, especially around topics like masculinity, male privilege, and consent, the Work Out project set out to do things differently. It brought together a multidisciplinary team: historians Dorothee Boulanger and Dr Alana Harris, artist Phoebe Davies, sports medicine specialist Alex Bowmer, and Gareth Esson from Tailor Education. The result was a rich, multifaceted exploration of sexual politics, power, and identity in educational spaces.

"It was really nice actually, to be given the opportunity to talk about mental health, harassment, and other issues with a group of guys you play with every week." – Workshop participant

A Multidisciplinary, Inclusive Model

What made Work Out stand out was its commitment to blending academic research with creative and practical methodologies. Drawing on Phoebe Davies’s 'print as protest' artistic practice and reflective dialogue sessions designed and delivered by Tailor Education, the project pushed the boundaries of what consent education for men could look like. The team embraced diversity at every level, ensuring that sexual, gender, ethnic, and religious identities were included and centred in both the process and outcomes.

Engaging Athletes, Reframing Masculinity

One of the project’s core strategies was to work with male-identifying athletes at King's College London. Sports teams often serve as crucibles for rigid gender roles and performative masculinity, making them key sites for cultural change. Through workshops and discussions, these athletes were invited to interrogate their understandings of power, privilege, and consent. The goal wasn’t to shame or lecture but to foster open, critical engagement — to create space for growth.

Grounded in Research, Driven by Dialogue

At the heart of Work Out was a research methodology rooted in collaboration and inclusion. Instead of imposing a fixed curriculum, the project evolved through ongoing dialogue with participants. This allowed the team to identify real gaps in existing approaches to sex and relationships education and to develop materials that were responsive, respectful, and resonant.

Tailor Education was key in developing reflective dialogue spaces and drawing on our expertise in creating trauma-informed, youth-led sex education. We facilitated safe, brave spaces where participants could navigate complex emotions, confront biases, and build empathy. This kind of consent education for men isn’t just about information; it’s about transformation.

Lasting Impact and Future Directions

The legacy of the Work Out project lies not only in the materials it produced but in the shift it represents. Over the course of the initiative, workshops engaged athletes from rugby, basketball, American football, boxing, and handball, fostering inclusive discussions across multiple teams and identities. It is a model for how institutions can take a more thoughtful, intersectional, and creative approach to sex and relationships education.

At Tailor Education, we’re proud to have helped shape this work, and we remain committed to integrating its lessons into everything we do. Learn more about our work on sex and relationships education with schools and universities or get in touch to collaborate. As we continue to expand our programmes, we're more certain than ever: if we want to build a more respectful and inclusive world, consent education for men must be bold, honest, and collaborative.
